# Sansad Chalo, 20 July 2026: hour by hour (draft for Vali)

Compiled 2026-11-12. The data lives in `data/story/sansad_chalo.json`: 10 steps, 75 facts, 8 deployment facts and 20 new source ids. Only 17 of those facts are already in the ledger; the rest are new.

**How to read this**
- Times are IST, as each outlet printed them. Live-blog times are posting times, so an event may have happened earlier.
- The dossier has no clock times for 20 July. Almost every time below comes from the **Tribune live blog** (TL), the **ThePrint live blog** (PL), **ThePrint "Top 10 developments"** (P10) or **PTI** copy.
- **[L]** means the item is already in the ledger, usually without a time. **[N]** means it is new.

## Timeline

**Night of 19–20 Jul: overnight "khaki zone"**
- Jantar Mantar becomes a "khaki zone": hundreds of police, 8-foot barricades welded together, riot-control vehicles (P10). [N]
- Entrance barricades are "welded shut", and the site is cordoned "on both sides" (Newslaundry). [N]
- Delhi Police buses, some carrying barricades, are on Sansad Marg, Tolstoy Marg and Jantar Mantar Road (Caravan). [N]
- Paramilitary forces in riot gear are stationed the night before (PTI). [N]
- 7.00 am: "over 300 police personnel" at the site (PL). [L]

**07:20–08:45: morning crowd, first baton charge**
- 7.20: CJP claims "one lakh supporters" (P10/PL). [N]
- 07:35–07:56: Commons photos (EXIF) show the gathering. [L media]
- 7.30: "the first of many baton-charges… near Park Hotel", pushing marchers towards Palika Bazaar (P10/PL). [N]
- No time: lathis on hundreds marching from Mandi House metro station (PTI eyewitnesses). [N; Mandi House is in the ledger as a place only]
- 8 am: the stone-laden truck is seen "on the road linking Sansad Marg to the protest site" (Newslaundry 28 Jul). [L, time new]
- 8.14: entry is "allowed only through Tolstoy Marg" (PL). [N]
- 8:34: police say no permission was sought or granted (TL). [L]

**09:00–10:15: protesters sealed in, metro and internet cut**
- Five stations are closed early: Rajiv Chowk, Janpath, Patel Chowk, Central Secretariat and Seva Teerth (PTI, The Week). [L] Seva Teerth is the renamed Udyog Bhawan station.
- 9.15: Rajiv Chowk and Central Secretariat reopen (PL).
- 9:26: Janpath, Patel Chowk and Seva Teerth stay shut (TL). [N]
- 9:23: "Mobile internet services are unavailable at Jantar Mantar" (TL). [L, time new]
- 9:33: protesters "not being allowed to leave the site" (TL). [N]
- 9:34: heavy security on Raisina Road and at Parliament Circle (TL). [N]
- 9:42: DCP Sachin Sharma meets CJP members (TL). [N]
- The 9 am procession "never formally started" (Outlook). [N]

**10:15–11:10: barricades toppled at Tolstoy Marg**
- 10.16: police vehicles parked across Tolstoy Marg; protesters topple barricades (PL). [N]
- 10:37: clash with RAF and police, then a lathi charge (TL). [N]
- 10.50: ANI reports "RPF personnel & police use lathis" (PL). [N]
- Lathis are used near the Kerala House lane (Newslaundry). [N]
- 11:07: **police deny** any violence; the protest is "handled professionally" (TL). [N]

**11:15–12:30: breach on Parliament Street**
- 11.15: a "major barricade" is broken. 11.25: protesters push at "multiple barricades in the high-security zone" (PTI). [N]
- They cross the SBI building on Sansad Marg, and police remove the barricades after a scuffle (Indian Express via Newslaundry). [N]
- Tear gas on the Sansad Marg–Parliament Street stretch and at the Tolstoy Marg junction (Outlook). [N]
- Parliament gates are shut (Newslaundry, P10). [N]
- Machine-gun firing positions at the Parliament gates (South First visuals; single source). [N]
- Dipke ends his fast: 11:38 (TL), 12.58 (PL), "around midday" (Outlook). [L, time new]
- 12:12: supporters gather inside Rajiv Chowk metro station (TL). [N]

**13:00–14:30: tear gas around Central Secretariat**
- ~1 pm: PTI says Section 163 was "imposed in the area". This conflicts with the DCP, who said it was already in force.
- 1:20: tear gas at Central Secretariat metro, Gate 2 (TL, PTI); several detained. [N]
- 1:25: baton charge; police and protesters injured (TL). [N]
- 1:55: protesters are pushed back from Raisina Road and gather outside the Press Club (TL; The Hindu via Newslaundry). [N]
- Before 1:57 pm: tear gas at Shastri Bhawan (PTI via Dynamite News). [N]
- Tear gas near Constitution Club (Wikipedia/The Wire). [L place]
- PTI's list of police barricade points: Constitution Club, Press Club, near Parliament, Parliament Street, Shankar Road, Jantar Mantar. [N]

**14:30–16:00: Patel Chowk, the heaviest charges**
- 3.08: "heavy lathicharge and tear gas" at Patel Chowk metro; protesters throw bottles (PL). P10 calls Patel Chowk the scene of the heaviest charges. [L place]
- 3:19: multiple tear gas rounds near Parliament Street (TL). [N]
- Mid-afternoon: tear gas at the Raisina Road roundabout and Constitution Club (P10). [N]
- Rail Bhawan: tear gas and lathi charge (PTI). [L] This confirms Rail Bhawan, which the 12 Nov web check could not find.
- Dipke "detained": Das claims it at 2:47 and retracts it at 3:55 (TL). South First says he was detained and released. **Disputed.**
- 3:17: SP says Dimple Yadav was detained (TL). [N]
- 3.29: police deny detentions (PL). [N]
- ~3 pm: Sahil Lochab is hit by pellets at Palika Bazar (Newslaundry 27 Jul). [N]
- 4:45 pm (publication time): "More than 20 protesters were detained, officials said" (PTI). [N]

**16:00–17:30: pellets in Connaught Place**
- ~4 pm: an Outlook reporter is hit at Palika Bazar; Safdarjung Hospital records "26 small, round wounds" (Newslaundry). [N]
- ~5 pm: Mansoori is hit near Palika Bazar (Newslaundry). [N]
- No time: video of RAF shotgun fire at the Regal complex (Newslaundry). [N]
- Pellet rounds: 2 per the police General Diary (Tribune) vs 7 rounds and 5 hits per a CRPF report (The Wire). [L]
- 4:56: stone pelting and a lathi charge are reported in Connaught Place (TL). [N]
- No time: stampede at the LIC building, Rajiv Chowk (Tribune). [N]
- 5:22: Gurdwara Bangla Sahib shelters people (TL). [L, time new]
- 4.53: Nadda says talks have been held (PL).

**17:30–20:40: hospitals fill, stage comes down**
- 5.30 pm: ~100 at RML, including 10 police, with 4 in the ICU (Newslaundry citing IE). [L]
- RML is overwhelmed and patients are diverted to Lady Hardinge (Newslaundry). [N]
- 7 pm: 65 medico-legal cases at RML (Wikipedia). [L]
- Late evening: "more than 200" brought to RML emergency, and 10–12 police treated per a senior doctor (Tribune 22 Jul). [N, conflicts]
- CJP claims ~150 hospitalised. [L]
- 5:38: the internet outage hits cab apps (TL). It lasts "until the evening" (The Week); no order was published (IFF). [N]
- 6:25 (TL) or 6.43 (PL): the stage is dismantled. [L, time new]
- Evening: Dipke, Das, Ranka and Angmo return to Jantar Mantar (South First). [N]
- 8:25 pm (publication time): "more than 100" detained, per police sources (PTI). [N]
- Detainees say they were beaten at Parliament Street police station (Caravan). [N]

**20:40–23:59: night, site cleared, police tally**
- 8.40: protesters "trapped" in tear gas near Patel Chowk, with barricades at all ends (PL). [N]
- 9:45: AFP says protesters pelted stones after tear gas (DC live). [N]
- 10:44: police wipe the site clean (TL). [L, time new]
- 10:55: a CJP sit-in continues near Kerala House (DC live). [N]
- 11:54 pm: the police statement (PTI) gives 118+ police injured, ~60 protesters injured, ~70 detained and 15–20 vehicles damaged. [L]

## Deployment, by claimant
- **5,000+ Delhi Police and paramilitary** personnel, with Vajra anti-riot vehicles and water cannons (Business Today, 8:23 am, unattributed). "Over 5,000 police personnel" (police sources, via PTI). 5,000+ and **25+ CAPF battalions** (India.com) [L].
- **14 district contingents** (each one ACP plus 100 personnel) plus **32 paramilitary companies** (Indian Express via Newslaundry). [N] Don't multiply this out on screen.
- **300+ at the site** (ThePrint). [L]
- RAF, a CRPF unit, acting "on instructions of the DCP" (General Diary via Tribune); plain-clothes personnel (Newslaundry).
- Section 163 BNSS was in force (DCP Sharma).
- No source gives police strength by hour or by position.

## Conflicts and unknowns
See `open_questions` in the JSON. The main ones:
- **First charge:** 7.30 near Park Hotel (ThePrint) vs the 10:37 entry (Tribune) vs the police denial at 11:07.
- **Detentions:** 20+ (4:45 pm) → 100+ (8:25 pm) → ~70 (11:54 pm) → later denial.
- **RML:** 100 / 65 MLCs / 200+.
- **Crowd:** 1 lakh (CJP) / 50,000+ (Caravan) / tens of thousands (Guardian) / 10,000+ (DCP).
- **Section 163** "imposed at 1 pm" vs already in force.
- **Barricade height:** 6 / 7 / 8 ft.
- **Pellets:** 2 vs 7 rounds.
- **"RPF" vs RAF.**
- **Raisina Road roundabout:** which one?
- **Barricade coordinates:** no source gives any, so every barricade line is `illustrative`. New map points are `approx` (OSM or known geography) or `illustrative`.

## Not verified
- Not fetched or blocked: HT, TOI, News18, Business Standard and Deccan Herald (403 or blocked); The Wire's pellet article (headline only); Indian Express (paywall rule).
- Many snippets came through a summarising fetch tool. Those are flagged in the JSON; re-check the wording on the page before quoting it on screen.
- The Caravan showed subscriber prompts. Confirm it isn't paywalled before citing it.
